title: Pale Ford Arch
description: A 25-metre barrel vault with a 3.7-metre freestanding slab deck, flared abutments and alternating open and solid limestone parapets.

review.notes: Round 2, closest to passing. Fixed: the deck is now a walkable stair run with a level crown; the end abutments are stepped; the full-surface grey mottling is gone. Not fixed: (1) the parapet is still one identical baluster/slot module repeated along the whole span (round-1 point); add heavier piers every few metres, a different crown panel, and break or chip a few balusters. (2) Material is now uniformly clean ivory with no weathering anywhere; add localized monument_weathered at the abutment bases/water line, in joints and under the parapet coping (local only, not full-surface). (3) The flat landing slabs at both ends sit on the ground like thin plates; give them thickness and tie them into the abutments/wing walls.
